stopRules: Stop for invalid instrumentation or generator-limited delivery; never treat these as architecture capacity.
Stop for a safety failure or changed frozen source, images, protocol, or host configuration.
Stop for review if no stable initial rate exists, integer resolution cannot meet 10%, or the resource/active-time/run ceiling is reached. Intentional pauses do not reset consumed budget.
Graceful pauses require a complete matched pair and verified cleanup/restoration. Failed or interrupted sessions require review, not automatic resume.
Do not automatically change the stability rule after observing results.
Do not execute the confirmatory matrix or claim preregistration.
